facts.fact: The Controller and Auditor General reviewed bills issued through the TAUSI system to 30 June 2025 and found TZS 1.22 billion issued by seven LGAs unpaid, and cites the revenue administration manual requiring system bills to update taxpayer records on payment.

PMO-RALG instructed LGAs on 31 January 2023 to install TAUSI by 31 March 2023 and stop collecting on LGRCIS; the audit draws TAUSI collection reports for 184 LGAs' own-source revenue (TZS 1.46 trillion in 2024/25) through PMO-RALG.
PMO-RALG operates TAUSI, adding a TAUSI module for property management under the mandate from January 2024 that moved property rates to LGAs.

At Dar es Salaam City Council, agents collected TZS 1.01 billion of solid waste fees on point-of-sale machines through the discontinued LGRCIS in 2024/25, of which TZS 742.29 million had been banked by 21 October 2025.

systems.tiers: 184 LGAs; property module, bills, business and service levies, land plot sales
